I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can already see it. I couldn't find any Brackenwater files in the share, so her post is the only source and I couldn't check the date against anything else.
